text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Yaeno Muteki and I bump into

Maruzensky while we're out and about.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wowzah! It's Yaeno and her trainer! ♪
Are you
two having a day out?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Maruzen! What a nice surprise. It's
truly an
honor to run into you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My father, you see, is a huge fan of
yours. He
often tells me tales of your
great
accomplishments.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Get outta town! Hearing that really
makes my
day!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I hear that you're also a master of
traditional
training methods. And being
unrivaled in speed
and skill alike... Truly,
you have my utmost
respect, Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I strive every day to achieve the kind of
success
you have.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Traditional methods? I don't really know
what you
mean, but I'm digging all the
compliments!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, bee-tee-dubs! I'm just on my way to
this
dynamite place I know. Do you two
want to come
with?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There just might be a groovy li'l secret
waiting for
you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Really?! I would be honored!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I can't help feeling like there's
a massive
misunderstanding, we find
ourselves following
Maruzensky to this
"dynamite place."

text_block_list.name: Bubbly Girls
text_block_list.text: Ciao, Maruzen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ciao, everyone! ♪ This here's my
classmate from
the academy, Yaeno, and
her trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce you to all the
members of
the Bubbly Club! We meet
up once a month to
talk about what's hip
and happenin' right now!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oho... You belong to the same dojo? It's
a
pleasure to meet you all.

text_block_list.name: Bubbly Girls
text_block_list.text: Word up, racer girl! ♪ Those threads of yours are outta sight! Cop a squat over here and I'll get you a drink.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, cool your jets, girlfriend! This gal
here's my
extra-special schoolmate.
You're cruisin' for a
bruisin' if you think
I'll let you have her all to
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Out of sight... Cooled Jets... Hmm...
What manner
of terminology is this? Are
these the names of
martial arts skills?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Here's the skinny, you two. The Bubbly
Squad's
always on the lookout for the
freshest pads and
hippest trends.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And today, you're honorary members of
the
party! Up first on the agenda is...

text_block_list.name: The Entire Bubbly Club
text_block_list.text: La la laaa! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm! An iron fan technique?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, don't hold back! I want you to get
real
jiggy, real fast!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Concealed weaponry... How profound!
Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Far out! You nailed it! Looks like you
could fight
till sunrise without batting an
eyelid! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Laa! Laa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Bubbly Club training in
"special"
techniques continues...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything today,
Maruzen. I
learned a great deal!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I had a total blast! ♪ If you
ever feel
like sampling the latest in
modern trends again,
you know who to
ask! Toodles! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen really is amazing. Even outside
the
academy, she trains diligently
alongside her
companions.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That said, she said "latest," but I felt the
whole
thing had more of a retro feel.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, she heavily implied that
their
activities were new in nature. She
must have
meant...
choice_data_list: そこは気づいてたのか……
そこは気づいてたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That what's old is new again!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Working ancient techniques into fresh
ideas... I
believe this must be the very
source of Maruzen's
strength!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Working ancient techniques into fresh
ideas... I
believe this must be the very
source of Maruzen's
strength!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. She is precisely as I'd envisioned
from
observing her races.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To have attained such mastery as a
student is
extraordinary. Maruzen is in a
different league
altogether.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If it's not too forward, I'm hoping she'll
allow me
to call her my venerable
teacher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I firmly insist that she does not pursue
that train
of thought, and our outing
draws to a close.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The Bubble Style, yes... Perhaps
someday that
style will come into
fashion in its own right and
bring about
something of a "bubble era."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It would be a peaceful period defined
by diligent
training and well-earned rest.
Truly, it would be a
time for both maxin'
and chillaxin'.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is something the matter? You look as if
you could
use a chill pill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since Yaeno Muteki can already sound a
bit
old-fashioned at times, I'm not sure
whether her
vernacular has become more
or less modern.
Either way, she speaks
like this for the next few
days.
